text: Science time with some mind-bending news. Researchers have figured out how to create entirely new forms of matter that technically shouldn't exist under normal conditions.

speaker: alice
text: By carefully timing magnetic field changes, they've unlocked exotic quantum states that could be way more stable for quantum computing. It's like discovering a new recipe for reality.

speaker: charlie
text: Meanwhile, scientists have also cracked the mystery of why the upper atmosphere is cooling while Earth's surface heats up. Turns out carbon dioxide acts as a coolant up there while trapping heat down here.
